sentence: This project builds virtual models of individual patients that learn from wearable health sensors and help guide insulin delivery for people with Type 1 diabetes.
This project studies how cyanine dyes come together to make compounds that give off shortwave infrared light.
This project supports a week-long summer school that introduces research in computer systems, machine learning, data visualization, and formal methods.
This project builds statistical methods that use heavy-tailed prior distributions to estimate astronomical distances and to model compositional data.
This project tests whether wild guppy populations adapt to a parasitic nematode through the same genetic changes or through different combinations of genes.
This project builds mathematical tools that make gradient-free optimization faster by using hidden low-dimensional structure in the problems.
This project develops methods that let aerial robots with arms do precise tasks, such as inspecting a structure by contact, despite wind disturbances.
This project looks for the genes that let poison frogs form spatial memories by comparing species that differ in memory abilities.
This project builds a plug-and-play DNA nano-cartridge that connects to conventional electronic circuits, aiming to make electronic biosensors that detect biomolecules.
This project uses experiments and mathematical modeling to study how DNA is arranged inside bacteriophage capsids and how it is delivered into bacterial cells during infection.
This project studies how cells in engineered bacterial colonies signal each other and builds mathematical models to predict colony behavior.
This project studies how polymers break down into microplastics and nanoplastics, using experiments and machine learning to find what controls their formation.
This project builds tools to find out what genes of unknown function do, using microbial strains that select for metabolic reactions.
This project studies how to make concrete structures underwater by additive manufacturing, using molecular dynamics simulations, sensors, and machine learning.
This project investigates a device that steers a beam of light quickly using electrical control of photonic crystal cavities built on vertical cavity surface-emitting laser arrays.
This project builds tools that let organizations use artificial intelligence to design analog and mixed-signal chips together without exposing confidential data.
This project builds and tests models of how tropical and temperate forests differ in structure, focusing on how trees compete for light.
